subject: Provisioning & Login Assurance — evidence request and next steps
messages:
From: Chloe Park <chloe.park@healthcloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Intake <security-intake@healthcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisioning & Login Assurance — initial evidence request

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our InfoSec team needs a short bundle showing how Redwood handles SSO, SCIM provisioning, and role-based access controls for the production tenant we discussed. Specifically we're looking for: 

- SAML metadata and example IdP configuration (EntityID, ACS URL, cert thumbprint)
- SCIM provisioning example payloads and provisioning logs showing a create/update cycle
- RBAC role mapping matrix and how admin/privileged access is restricted (least privilege controls)
- Where logs/audit trails for user access are stored and retention policy

Can you provide the files or a link with the artifacts by EOD Friday (Nov 20)?

You can DM me if any of these require an exception or short walkthrough.

Thanks,
Chloe Park
Security Engineer | HealthCloud Inc

---
Attachment: request_template.csv (CSV)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Park <chloe.park@healthcloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Provisioning & Login Assurance — initial evidence request

Chloe —

Appreciate the clear list. We've started pulling the artifacts. Quick notes and plan: 

- I'll share a Drive folder with the SAML metadata and the exported redwood_saml_metadata.xml. That file contains EntityID, ACS URLs, and current cert thumbprint. (See link below).
- Rishi will export a short SCIM trace demonstrating a user create + attribute sync; we'll include both the example payload (scim_provisioning_sample.csv) and a sanitized log extract.
- Laura will attach the RBAC matrix (rbac_matrix_v1.xlsx) showing default roles, permission groups, and the admin approval workflow.
- We'll include our audit log retention statement and a short diagram of where logs live (internal logging cluster -> encrypted object storage, 90-day hot, 1-year cold by default).

Two quick asks from us: 
1) For the production tenant you referenced, can you confirm the SP EntityID you plan to use so we can include a sample metadata entry with the exact ACS?
2) If HealthCloud requires SOC2 Type II artifacts beyond the summary, let me know and we'll escalate to our compliance team.

Deliverables will be posted to a shared folder and I'll send a follow-up with a walkthrough slot (30 mins) for Friday morning PST.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
